collection.description: A visitor asks why a villager taps their bowl three times before every meal: make something up, or tell the truth.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Before every meal, (subject) taps the edge of (subject.his/her) bowl three times. (subject.He/She) started doing it as a small child and has no idea why. Today, (visitor), a visitor from another village, notices and asks what it means.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "It's to let the food know it's about to be eaten," says (subject) solemnly. "Out of respect." (visitor) nods slowly and taps (visitor.his/her) own bowl three times. By the end of the meal, half the table is doing it. (subject) has started a tradition by accident.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a snack, a basket of fruit); the village's stores do not change

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "I don't actually know," (subject) admits. "I just always have." (visitor) thinks about this. "I always put my left sandal on first," (visitor.he/she) confesses. "Every single day." They look at each other with deep understanding.
